content: RIVER "will drown you in pure terror." (TheWrap) Only in theaters January 15 The sun is down. The boat is dead. There’s no cell service. And there’s someone standing, staring, from the shore. From the producers of Backrooms and Obsession comes a vivid, visceral new vision in the slasher genre, marking an electrifying feature-film debut by writer-director Joshua Giuliano. River stars Jane Levy (Don’t Breathe, Evil Dead), Jessica Rothe (Happy Death Day films, Pulse) and Max Mattern (Cape Fear, Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy) as estranged siblings who reunite in their rural hometown after the death of their father. As they set out to scatter his ashes at his favorite spot on a remote river, the trip devolves into a fight for survival as they are mercilessly hunted by a disturbing masked figure played by Dane DiLiegro (Prey, Only Murders in the Building). Acquired by Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic Monster following a rapturous screening at Midnight Madness at the Toronto International Film Festival, River is produced by Steven Schneider (executive producer Insidious franchise, Split) via his company Spooky Pictures, and Nick Antosca (creator Cape Fear series, Verity) and Alex Hedlund (executive producer Cape Fear series, Verity) via their company Eat The Cat. The film’s executive producers are Jeffrey Tinnell, Robert Tinnell, Matt Brodlie, Jonathan Kier, Ben Ross and Jason Blum. Universal Pictures, Blumhouse Atomic Monster and Independent Film Company present a Shudder Original Production, in association with Upgrade. chineseContent: RIVER“会让你淹没在纯粹的恐惧之中”。 (TheWrap) 仅限影院上映 1 月 15 日太阳落山。船死了。没有手机服务。有人站在岸边凝视着。 《幕后室》和《痴迷》的制片人为恐怖片类型带来了生动、发自肺腑的新视野，标志着编剧兼导演约书亚·朱利亚诺的惊心动魄的故事片处女作。 《河流》由简·莱维（《屏住呼吸》、《鬼玩人》）、杰西卡·罗德（《忌日快乐》系列电影、《脉搏》）和马克斯·马特恩（《恐惧角》、《魔鬼伪装：约翰·韦恩·盖西》）饰演疏远的兄弟姐妹，他们在父亲去世后在农村家乡团聚。当他们出发将他的骨灰撒在一条偏远的河流上他最喜欢的地方时，这次旅行演变成了一场生存之战，因为他们遭到戴恩·迪利格罗（戴恩·迪利格罗（《猎物》、《大楼里唯一的谋杀案》）饰演）令人不安的蒙面人物无情的追捕。 《River》在多伦多国际电影节《午夜疯狂》中大受欢迎后被环球影业和 Blumhouse Atomic Monster 收购，由史蒂文·施奈德（《潜伏》系列《分裂》执行制片人）通过他的公司 Spooky Pictures 制作，尼克·安托斯卡（《开普恐惧》系列《Verity》创作者）和亚历克斯·赫德伦德（《开普恐惧》系列《Verity》执行制片人）通过他们的公司 Eat The Cat 制作。该片的执行制片人包括杰弗里·廷内尔、罗伯特·廷内尔、马特·布罗德利、乔纳森·基尔、本·罗斯和杰森·布鲁姆。环球影业、Blumhouse Atomic Monster 和独立电影公司与 Upgrade 联合推出了《Shudder Original Production》。社交手柄 Facebook：https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61594993220540# Instagram：https://www.instagram.com/rivermovie TikTok：http://www.tiktok.com/@riverthefilm 官方网站：http://www.river.movi​​e #RiverMovie
